modules.name: search-retrieval
modules.title: Search Retrieval
modules.description: Calls SearXNG meta-search engine, parses JSON responses, and normalizes results into a unified candidate structure (title/url/snippet/score). Handles timeout, retry, and failover for SearXNG public or self-hosted instances.

modules.name: scrape-extract
modules.title: Scrape and Extract
modules.description: Converts URLs to clean text content using cheerio+readability as the primary path and Puppeteer as fallback for JS-rendered pages. Handles HTTP errors, encoding detection, content truncation, and non-HTML resources.

modules.name: deduplicate
modules.title: Deduplicate and Denoise
modules.description: Performs URL normalization (strip tracking params, unify scheme/case, remove fragments) and content-level deduplication using paragraph fingerprinting and similarity threshold comparison to merge near-duplicate articles.

modules.name: synthesize
modules.title: LLM Synthesize
modules.description: Interacts with an OpenAI-compatible LLM to produce structured digests (Answer/Key Points/Sources) from deduplicated content. Manages prompts, handles LLM failures, token limits via batch-and-merge, and graceful degradation.

modules.name: pipeline-orchestration
modules.title: Pipeline Orchestration
modules.description: Orchestrates the Search→Scrape→Deduplicate→Synthesize pipeline for web_search and the Scrape→Synthesize sub-flow for web_fetch. Manages concurrency limits, overall timeouts, and error isolation across individual URL failures.

modules.name: mcp-server
modules.title: MCP Server Entry
modules.description: Manages MCP server lifecycle over stdio transport: JSON-RPC message handling, tool definition registration (web_search/web_fetch inputSchemas), call dispatch to the orchestration layer, and MCP-standard response formatting.
